LanguageData.HH.Ai.Badge.TipChat: Written by the AI from a read-only snapshot of your books. It can explain, it cannot change anything.

LanguageData.HH.Ai.Badge.Written: Written by the AI. The stars come from the game.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Chat.NoAccount: There is no account yet. Open one in the lobby first and I will gladly look at it.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Chat.NoMatch: I can only answer a few questions from the books on my own. Use the quick questions below, or ask again when the AI is back.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Chat.OfflineHint: The AI is not available, so Ottoline answers from the books if she can.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Chat.Placeholder: Ask Ottoline anything about your money...
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Chat.QuickTip: Answered at once from your books. Nothing is sent anywhere.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Chat.Welcome: Ask me about your account, loans, investments or policies. I explain; I never move your money. If the AI is away, the quick questions below still work.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Concierge.Offline: The AI did not answer; these are the game's own tips.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Concierge.Placeholder: Why are no nobles coming? What should I improve?
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Concierge.StateAi: AI online: answers are phrased by the AI
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Concierge.StateOffline: Answers come from the game's own tips
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Concierge.Tips: Here is what I see, most common first:
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Concierge.Title: Ask the concierge
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.Budget: The AI budget is shared by all players over 24 hours. When it is used up, the AI rests and the game uses its own texts.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.D.Claim: Claim letters: the policy, the pawn's name, the incident, the decision and the amount that the game already decided, and what you wrote in the claim form (600 letters at most).
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.D.Concierge: Concierge: your question (300 letters at most) and up to 12 short facts, such as renown, number of guests and beds, and the problems the game found.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.D.Headline: Market headlines: the kind of market event, the name of the asset and the size of the move. At most 8 events per request.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.D.Ottoline: Ask Ottoline: your question (500 letters at most) and a snapshot of the books: balance, savings, up to 10 loans, investments, policies and recent bookings, as numbers and short labels.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.D.Review: Guest reviews: the guest's first name, the stars the game gave, a few reason words (for example the way they left) and the kinds of venue they spent money in.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.Done: AI texts are on. The game checks the relay now.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.Intro: Hearth & Harbor can let an AI write some flavour texts: Clerk Ottoline's chat answers, market headlines, guest reviews, insurance claim letters and the concierge's tips. The game plays exactly the same without it, and it always has its own texts ready for when the AI is away.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.NotSent: What is NOT sent: your Steam name or id, file paths, the name of your save or colony, your other mods, or anything that looks like a key.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.Sent: What is sent: game text for the request, for example pawn names (up to 64 letters), amounts, the text you type into the chat, the claim form or the concierge box, and counts such as guests or beds.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.Stored: What is stored: the relay keeps only counters (how many tokens, what it cost, how long it took, error codes). It does not keep what you wrote or what the AI answered. Like any web server, the host of the relay may briefly hold your IP address in its technical connection logs.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.Title: AI texts (optional)
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.Where: Where it goes: to a small relay server run by the author of this mod (hh-relay.jberger.de), and from there through OpenRouter to Anthropic's Claude models, using only providers that keep no data (zero data retention).
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Consent.Withdraw: You can withdraw at any time: Mod settings, Hearth & Harbor, AI flavour, Forget my consent.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Notice.Title: Hearth & Harbor: a note about the AI texts
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Panel.ConsentNone: You have not agreed yet. Nothing is sent.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Panel.ForgetConfirm: Forget your consent and switch the AI module off? Nothing is sent from then on. You can agree again at any time.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Panel.Relay: Relay: shared budget used {0} % of the last 24 hours. This session: {1} sent, {2} ok, {3} failed, {4} own texts used.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.1.0: One star, and only because the form has no zero.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.1.1: I asked for a quiet night and got a lesson in patience.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.1.2: Never again, though the door was lovely on the way out.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.1.3: I have stayed in worse. I cannot remember where.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.2.0: It was fine if you like waiting. I do not.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.2.2: The staff tried. The building did not help.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.2.3: Two stars: one for the effort, one for the door.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.3.0: A room, a roof and a reasonably warm welcome.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.3.1: Nothing to complain about and nothing to write home about, so here I am.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.3.2: Decent. I would come back if the road happened to bring me.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.3.3: Three stars. The middle of the road is a fine place to stand.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.4.0: Good food, kind people, a bed that behaved itself.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.4.1: I slept well and paid fairly. That is rarer than it sounds.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.4.2: Pleasant and well run. I will tell my caravan.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.4.3: Four stars. Something was missing and I forgot what, which says plenty.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.5.0: Best stay of the season. The staff remembered my name and my order.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.5.1: I came for a night and almost forgot to leave.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.5.2: Warm, clean, funny. Five stars and a handshake.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Fallback.5.3: I would live here if they let me, and they might not.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.Review.Label: Guest review: {0}
LanguageData.HH.Ai.State.NoConsent: AI texts are not set up
LanguageData.HH.Ai.State.NoConsent.Tip: Nothing is sent anywhere until you agree. The game uses its own texts.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.State.Off.Tip: Switch the module on in the Hearth & Harbor settings.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.State.Offline.Tip: The relay could not be reached. The game uses its own texts and tries again later.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.State.Online.Tip: The relay answers. Texts written by the AI are marked.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.State.Paused: AI paused for a few minutes
LanguageData.HH.Ai.State.Paused.Tip: Several requests failed in a row. The game uses its own texts for ten minutes.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.State.Resting.Tip: The shared daily budget of the relay is used up. The game uses its own texts until it recovers.
LanguageData.HH.Ai.State.Unavailable.Tip: The relay is switched off or not ready. The game uses its own texts.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.func.claim.Desc: The answer letters of Clawback Mutual react to what you wrote in the claim form. The decision and the amount never change.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.func.concierge.Desc: Ask the concierge a question about running your guests. It phrases the tips the game already knows.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.func.headline: Market headlines
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.func.headline.Desc: The Rim Exchange news ticker gets headlines written by the AI. The numbers behind them do not change.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.func.ottoline.Desc: Chat with Clerk Ottoline in the bank. She explains your accounts, loans, investments and policies. Without AI she answers a few quick questions from the books.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.func.review.Desc: Some departing guests leave a review written in their own voice. Without AI the review is a short stock line.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.maxPerDay.Desc: A courtesy limit of this game on its own requests, per in-game day. 0 = no local limit. The relay has its own shared daily budget.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.reviewShare: Share of departing groups that leave a review
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.reviewShare.Desc: Keeps the number of AI requests small. 25 % means about one group in four.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.ai.showBadge.Desc: Adds a note to AI-written guest reviews and shows the AI badge in the chat and the concierge box. Market headlines get no mark.
